# TPC-DS-OBT Q63

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    obt.item_i_manager_id,
    SUM(obt.sales_price) AS sum_sales,
    AVG(SUM(obt.sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY obt.item_i_manager_id) AS avg_monthly_sales
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_month_seq IN (
        1176,
        1176 + 1,
        1176 + 2,
        1176 + 3,
        1176 + 4,
        1176 + 5,
        1176 + 6,
        1176 + 7,
        1176 + 8,
        1176 + 9,
        1176 + 10,
        1176 + 11
      )
      AND (
        (
          obt.item_i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Electronics')
          AND obt.item_i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help')
          AND obt.item_i_brand IN (
            'scholaramalgamalg #14',
            'scholaramalgamalg #7',
            'exportiunivamalg #9',
            'scholaramalgamalg #9'
          )
        )
        OR (
          obt.item_i_category IN ('Women', 'Music', 'Men')
          AND obt.item_i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants')
          AND obt.item_i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1')
        )
      )
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    obt.item_i_manager_id,
    obt.sold_date_d_moy
) AS tmp1
WHERE
  CASE
    WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0
    THEN CAST(ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(avg_monthly_sales, 0)
    ELSE NULL
  END > 0.1
ORDER BY
  item_i_manager_id,
  avg_monthly_sales,
  sum_sales
LIMIT 100
```
